avis.titre: Excellent choice for kidsExcellent choice for kids
avis.texte: The 2-in-1 is a great choice and offers excellent value for money. My sons love it because it’s tear-free—they’re very sensitive to soap getting into their eyes. I also like the gentle fragrance, and it leaves the skin feeling soft and moisturized. I even use it myself! 😄

avis.titre: Gentle, Tear-Free, and Great for Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: We’ve had a great experience with the Cetaphil 2-in-1 Baby Shampoo & Body Wash. It cleans both hair and skin well without being harsh, rinses off easily, and leaves my child’s skin feeling soft without any dryness. One thing we especially appreciate is that it doesn’t cause any eye irritation during bath time, which makes washing hair much easier. The gentle formula has a light, pleasant scent and works well for sensitive skin. It’s convenient to have a single product for both shampoo and body wash, and I would definitely recommend it to other parents.

I’ve been using this shampoo since My Baby was born. He’s now three years old. I absolutely love Cetaphil. They’re super moisturizing very light and smells amazing. There’s zero irritation brand has been consistent since 2023. I even love their regular collection as well and they’re absolutely tear-free. And I they’re well priced.
